StatusRecord.title: StatusRecord
StatusRecord.description: Represents a proposal status (Status Propostas) or cancellation reason (Motivos de Recusa) mapped by convenio and banco.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator/owner

tipoProposta.description: Whether the record is for an ongoing proposal (em_andamento) or a cancelled proposal reason (cancelada)

convenio.description: Coluna Convenio (e.g., INSS, SIAPE, FGTS, Governo Estadual)

banco.description: Coluna Banco (e.g., Banrisul, Banco Pan, C6 Consig)

codigoInterno.description: Optional internal bank code or reference code

significado.description: Coluna Significado: Detailed operational meaning of this status or cancellation reason

atuacao.description: Coluna Atuação: Detailed action plan and instructions for the operator

responsabilidade.description: Coluna Responsabilidade de Atuação: Party responsible for the next step or resolution

palavrasChave.description: Comma-separated synonyms or common search terms

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated

/status_records/{recordId}.description: Collection storing status records (Status Propostas) and refusal reasons (Motivos de Recusa) in the database.
